newsitem.title: CHINA: At least 45 dead in China boat tragedies.
newsitem.headline: At least 45 dead in China boat tragedies.

text.p: At least 45 people, including 23 schoolchildren, died and three people are missing after two boats capsized in separate accidents in eastern China last weekend, state media said on Wednesday.

A boat carrying a group of 45 students and teachers capsized last Saturday on a reservoir in Zhangpu county in the eastern province of Zhejiang, killing 23 pupils and one of their teachers, the China Women's News said.
The accident happened because the group had greatly exceeded the six-metre (20-foot) boat's capacity of 12 passengers, the newspaper said. It gave no further details.
In the city of Jiaonan in the eastern province of Shandong, a fishing boat carrying 40 people, mostly women, flipped over in a storm on Sunday, state radio said.
At least 21 people drowned and three were missing, the radio said, adding that search efforts were still under way. It gave no further details.
